segments.normalizedSource: ```swift .toolbar { ToolbarSpacer(.flexible) ToolbarItem { ShareLink(item: landmark, preview: landmark.sharePreview) } ToolbarSpacer(.fixed) ToolbarItemGroup { LandmarkFavoriteButton(landmark: landmark) LandmarkCollectionsMenu(landmark: landmark) } ToolbarSpacer(.fixed) ToolbarItem { Button("Info", systemImage: "info") { modelData.selectedLandmark = landmark modelData.isLandmarkInspectorPresented.toggle() } } } ```
